_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail (GeyserMC's own Pterodactyl egg was only read for reference): Geyser-Standalone.jar from GeyserMC's download API v2 with the SHA-256 it lists checked, latest or a pinned version and build; a build that does not exist fails the install. Bedrock clients join on the allocation (UDP); the Bedrock bind address and port, the Java server and the auth type are passed as Geyser's --key=value options, so they apply from the first start, before Geyser has written config.yml. Tagged minecraft, bedrock and proxy with the minecraft_bedrock flag: the node pings it like a Bedrock server (Geyser answers with the Java server's MOTD and players), and a Bedrock proxy gets no Minecraft tools (no server.properties, players, plugins or version changer of its own). No EULA prompt (Geyser is not a Mojang server). Java 25 and 21 images (Geyser needs Java 21), install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: Geyser Standalone
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Geyser lets Minecraft: Bedrock Edition players (phones, consoles, Windows) join a Minecraft: Java Edition server. The standalone proxy runs next to the Java server, which it connects to like a Java client.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Geyser Standalone installation (Octail): Geyser-Standalone.jar from GeyserMC's download API (v2), checked
# against the SHA-256 the API lists for the build. A build that doesn't exist fails the install instead of
# silently installing another one.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -eu

API=https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/geyser/versions
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-geyser.jar}"
GVERSION="${GEYSER_VERSION:-latest}"
BUILD="${GEYSER_BUILD:-latest}"

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$1"; }

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

[ -n "${GVERSION}" ] || GVERSION=latest
[ -n "${BUILD}" ] || BUILD=latest
echo "${GVERSION}" | grep -Eq '^(latest|[0-9][0-9A-Za-z.-]*)$' ||
	fail "the Geyser version (${GVERSION}) must be a version or latest"
case "${BUILD}" in
latest) ;;
*[!0-9]*) fail "the Geyser build (${BUILD}) must be a number or latest" ;;
esac

INFO=$(get "${API}/${GVERSION}/builds/${BUILD}") ||
	fail "GeyserMC's download API has no Geyser ${GVERSION} build ${BUILD}"
NUMBER=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.build // empty')
VERSION=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.version // empty')
SHA256=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.downloads.standalone.sha256 // empty' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
if [ -z "${NUMBER}" ] || [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
	fail "GeyserMC's download API named no version or build number"
fi
echo "${SHA256}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' || fail "GeyserMC's download API gave no SHA-256 for build ${NUMBER}"

echo "Installing Geyser Standalone ${VERSION} build ${NUMBER} as ${JAR}"
rm -f "${JAR}.download"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -o "${JAR}.download" "${API}/${VERSION}/builds/${NUMBER}/downloads/standalone" ||
	fail "the download of Geyser build ${NUMBER} failed"
GOT=$(sha256sum "${JAR}.download" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${SHA256}" ]; then
	rm -f "${JAR}.download"
	fail "SHA-256 mismatch for Geyser build ${NUMBER} (expected ${SHA256}, got ${GOT})"
fi
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"

echo "Geyser Standalone ${VERSION} build ${NUMBER} installed (SHA-256 ${SHA256} checked)."
echo "Geyser writes config.yml on its first start. The Bedrock port, the Java server and its auth type come from the Startup tab."

variables.name: Java Server Address
variables.description: The host name or IP address of the Minecraft: Java Edition server Bedrock players join through Geyser. For a server on this panel, use the address shown on its Network tab.

variables.name: Java Server Port
variables.description: The port of that Java Edition server.

variables.name: Auth Type
variables.description: How Bedrock players log in to the Java server: online (each needs a Java Edition account), offline (the Java server must have online-mode=false) or floodgate (the Floodgate plugin on the Java server lets them in without a Java account; copy its key.pem into this server's folder).

variables.name: Geyser Version
variables.description: The Geyser version to install, such as 2.11.3, or latest.

variables.name: Geyser Build
variables.description: The build of that version, or latest for its newest build.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the Geyser jar file.
